Class SavingsCalculator.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.savings.SavingsCalculator.Builder
Enclosing class:
SavingsCalculator
public static final class SavingsCalculator.Builder extends Object
Fluent configuration for a savings estimate, terminated by calculate(). Setters validate eagerly (fail-fast IllegalArgumentExceptions), so a mistake surfaces at the call site rather than as a wrong number later.

Defaults: 1000 Mbps bandwidth, EVPL_VC connection type, Term.MONTH_12, egress volume 0 GB, no Cloud Router, and the standard layered rate-card chain (live Equinix pricing, then bundled reference figures).

    • includeCloudRouter

      public SavingsCalculator.Builder includeCloudRouter(String packageCode)
      Adds a Fabric Cloud Router of the given package to the interconnect cost (none is included by default). If the rate card cannot price the package — or prices it in a different currency from the connection — the interconnect figures stay partial (connection only), isEquinixPriced() flips false, and the estimate's disclaimer names the excluded router; the router is never silently dropped from an estimate reported as complete.
      Parameters:
      packageCode - the router package code (e.g. "STANDARD")
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the package code is null or blank

    • rateCard

      public SavingsCalculator.Builder rateCard(RateCard rateCard)
      Sets the rate card that prices both egress and Equinix interconnect resources. When omitted, the standard layered chain (RateCard.standardChain(fabric)) applies: live Equinix Fabric pricing first, then the bundled ReferenceRateCard, which also supplies indicative cloud-egress rates — so egress savings are computed out of the box with no card supplied. A supplied card replaces that chain entirely (it is not layered over the defaults); to keep the defaults as a fallback behind your own figures, pass RateCard.layered(customCard, RateCard.standardChain(fabric)).
      Parameters:
      rateCard - the rate card to price with, or null to use the standard chain
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
